articles.title: Is GTA 6 a swan song for big-budget triple-A?
articles.summary: This article was first published in the PocketGamer.biz newsletter. Subscribe for more content like this straight to your inbox here - you'll even get discounts on PGC events. There’s no escaping Rockstar’s blockbuster launch of GTA 6 this week.Sure, it’s a console launch. But it’s more than that, the franchise is a global phenomenon and its release, 13 years after GTA V landed, represents a rare cultural moment for games. Even the BBC had live 24-hour coverage as it launched around the world.The scale of the buzz has been seen a handful of times before with the likes of Fortnite and Pokémon Go. That’s not to forget a different kind of virality from Roblox hits like Steal a Brainrot and Grow a Garden, garnering tens of millions of concurrent players. But the scale of GTA’s development is unprecedented, providing what appears to be unlimited resources and time to create an inevitable hit.It’s hard to think that any other studio could execute on something similar. The industry has seen plenty of big-budget games, of course. In China, there’s ambition and resources to create large open-world games that are playable across platforms. Like Genshin Impact, for example. ... [ MORE ]
